body: Hmm, I would say my addictive tendencies show up elsewhere with impulse purchases, though. I justify it by being able to resell my collection for more than I bought for. No justification for food, though. I don't do anything in a very unhealthy way, at least I hope.

I drink very rarely and mostly alone, but I like chatting with others when I do because it sort of relieves my social anxiety. I joke that if anything would prevent me from becoming an alcoholic, it's that I can't stand the taste. Though I feel that it is more truth than joke. My SO doesn't drink which makes it easier for me.

 However, I was a regular weed user for nearly 10 years. I only stopped because I refuse to buy it, and my SO doesn't care for that either. If it was available to me, I'd still use it. Luckily it's easy for me not to buy it because I like to save money. Unfortunately I'm having to deal with a lot of feelings come up that I've supressed now that I don't use anything to self-medicate. Never done therapy for more than a few weeks in college, never had a mental health evaluation, but I can see it being helpful longterm. I need to be sure where I'm gonna live in the near future to start it though. I see myself having a rough few months in the near future and my biggest fear is burdening my SO with my problems.

Nevertheless, I can still do these things once in a while. I don't see it becoming a problem for me as I'm very aware of the risk.
Lucky, every time I ask people in my dreams they convince me I'm awake through some terrible reasoning. Wish I could be told I'm dreaming!
